reference_sql:
SELECT a.segment, ROUND(SUM(-e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit), 2) AS churned_mrr
FROM subscription_events e
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id
WHERE e.event_type = 'churn'
  AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY a.segment
alternatives:
WITH churned AS (
  -- one row per churn event in 2024 or 2025, in euros
  SELECT e.account_id, -e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS lost_eur
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  WHERE e.event_type = 'churn'
    AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT a.segment, ROUND(SUM(c.lost_eur), 2) AS churned_mrr
FROM churned c
JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = c.account_id
GROUP BY a.segment

SELECT a.segment, ROUND(SUM(ABS(e.mrr_delta_local) * f.eur_per_unit), 2) AS churned_mrr
FROM accounts a
JOIN subscription_events e ON e.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
WHERE e.event_type = 'churn'
  AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY a.segment

solver.query:
WITH ev AS (SELECT e.account_id, a.segment, e.event_type, e.event_date, s.currency, e.mrr_delta_local AS d, e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS eur
  FROM subscription_events e JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31') SELECT segment, ROUND(-SUM(eur), 2) AS churned_mrr FROM ev WHERE event_type = 'churn' AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY segment
